sentence: This project tests whether imaging-targeted magnetic stimulation treats treatment-resistant depression better than scalp-targeted stimulation.
This project searches for drugs that turn on a type of channel that controls brain activity, using virtual screening and machine learning.
This project tests whether faulty microglia link Alzheimer-type dementia and vascular dementia in hypertensive small vessel disease.
This project tries to find which lipid mediators, and which receptors and cell types, can reduce endometriosis pain and lesions in a mouse model.
This project builds tools and models to choose the right RNA for epigenome editing with CRISPR while limiting off-target binding.
This project builds an evolutionary model of how SARS-CoV-2 changes during long infections in immunocompromised people and spreads new variants.
This project uses deep learning to measure cerebrovascular lesions and studies how they affect Alzheimer's disease biomarkers and cognitive decline.
This project uses photon avalanching nanoparticles to build a near infrared imaging system that sees live cells at high resolution.
This project builds a smart pacifier that emits sound and uses AI to analyze breathing sound reflections to monitor lung function in neonates.
This project studies how drug use is changing in rural settings and evaluates remote, contactless delivery of prevention services.
This project studies how cells sense sterols to trigger degradation of the cholesterol enzyme HMGCR, and how this could overcome statin-resistance.
This project does patient-oriented research on preventing cardiometabolic disease in children.
This project tests foot-worn devices that measure stride-by-stride gait to track real-world walking in children with neuromuscular disorders.
This project expands genomic testing in a clinical laboratory to improve patient care and meet public health goals.
This project studies how the causes of atrial fibrillation differ between males and females, using computer models.
This project studies how defective pro-viruses and viral proteins in HIV reservoirs cause bystander damage and affect viral latency.
This project tests whether a thrombus-targeting fusion protein protects hearts better than ticagrelor plus heparin in a porcine model of myocardial infarction.
This project coats dentures with layers of salivary peptides and proteins to control Candida biofilm and denture stomatitis.
This project tries to find out how rhabdomyosarcoma arises from a cell that is not a myogenic cell, using mouse models.
